nurse.text: Kaliméra. Nicosia Sanctuary. It's forty degrees in August and we're the only building with working air conditioning, so be quick.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Pop them down. We've had all sorts today: a heatstroke, a cat bite and a man who tried to grill his own halloumi indoors.
All better. Drink water. Wear a hat. Never argue with a Cypriot grandmother about food.
The Ark's in the back. Mind the fan, it's older than the Republic.

else.text: Siga siga, slowly slowly. That's the island's motto.
